Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 6
Reason for Mistake: In Step 6, the Planner incorrectly inferred that the parent company of Apple Records is Universal Music Group (UMG) based on historical distribution details ("EMI's catalog is now part of Universal Music Group"). This is a logical error because the question asks which company the record label is *part of* (i.e., its corporate parent/owner), not which company distributes its music. Apple Records is a division of Apple Corps Ltd, regardless of who handles distribution (EMI historically, UMG currently). The Planner's confusion between corporate ownership and distribution rights led to the wrong conclusion.
